title: Items waiting on a person's placement
description: What GET /api/v1/review answers and `ingestion review list --json` prints: each item that waits on a person, the longest waiting first: one that the side gate sent to review, one that holds no usable parse, and one that the quality gate sent to review before any side decision. POST /api/v1/review/{key}/place takes one of the destinations the set in force declares but a push-only one, and answers schemas/review-placement.schema.json. A caller holding ingestion.review.read reads each item's title, URL, quality answer and sightings' fields here, without ingestion.items.read. Where the zone is outside, each is a stranger's text or a model's reading of it.

reason.description: Why the item waits: its sightings' tags disagree, the guess fell below the floor, a connector that sighted it leaves its side to a person and the guess waits beside it, no tag or rule placed it and the quality gate gave no answer, because its run failed, its scan could not read the set in force, or it waited in review from before the quality gate ran, the side gate could not read the set in force or the item's sightings, it has no usable parse, the quality gate sent it to review, or the quality gate would drop it and a family of it has not earned hiding it, or the family's draw showed it, or a routing rule that a person accepted would drop it or place it and the rule's review share drew it, or a read by a model waits on its note, whose draft fell below the note floor, or a person sorted it to learning and the quality gate's newest answer did not pass it, whose reason the quality answer holds.

rule.description: The routing rule that would have decided the item, where it waits as rule-would-hide, and null under any other reason: its name, and the destination that a keep would place it on, null where a block would drop it.

guess.description: The quality gate's side guess, where it gave one. It is present under any reason, and a reader shows it wherever it is present rather than by the reason.

quality_answer.description: The quality gate's newest done answer, in the shape prompts/quality/answer.schema.json holds. Null where the gate gave none. Its idea and themes are a model's reading of the item, so they take the item's zone.

note_draft.description: The note stage's newest done draft, in the shape prompts/note/answer.schema.json holds: the questions for a model read to answer, why the item was likely saved, how it bears on the owner's current work, a summary, a one-line idea and a confidence. Null where none was drafted. A model wrote it from the item, so it takes the item's zone. Placing the item with no note takes the draft.

source_ts.description: When the item's artifact was made at its source, such as a video's upload, and null where the source gave none.

channel.description: Who published the item, as its sightings name it, such as a video's channel or a save's subreddit as r/<name>, and null where none does. Its source wrote it.

channel_fields.description: The sighting fields that a drop decided by the channel stands for, which a drop's menu offers as the one cause channel. Empty where a drop names the channel's field as its own cause, as a save's subreddit.

length_s.description: How long the item runs, in seconds, and null where no sighting carries a length.

views.description: How many views the item drew at its source, and null where no sighting counts them.

likes.description: How many likes the item drew at its source, and null where no sighting counts them.

comment_count.description: How many comments the item drew at its source, and null where no sighting counts them.

comments.description: How the read of what the item's top comments say stands, which a person asks for on its review card with POST /api/v1/items/{key}/comments. unread where nobody asked, reading while its task or its run has not ended, unclaimed while its task waits and no worker heard from lately claims comments tasks, done with the answer in the shape prompts/comments/answer.schema.json holds, and failed where its task failed, which a second request asks again. Null where no source that the build carries reads the item's comments. A model wrote the answer over strangers' comments, so it is outsider text.

error.description: Why the read failed, and null unless it did.

sightings.description: Each connector's arrival of the item: the tags the side gate read, and the source's fields, such as a Reddit save's subreddit, which a routing rule matches.

metrics.description: The source's counts by name, such as a video's views.

verbs.description: Each sort verb that POST /api/v1/review/{key}/sort takes, in the order the review tab binds them, with the destination it places an item on under the set in force. destination is null for a verb that places on none, as a shelf does, and missing where the set declares none that the verb takes, so the verb refuses. playlist is true for a verb whose sort picks a playlist. Null where the set in force could not be read.

playlist.description: Whether the verb's deliverer adds the item to the playlist that the sort picks, or to watch_default_playlist where it picks none.

missing.description: Why the verb places nothing under the set in force, and null where it places.

watch_default_playlist.description: The playlist that a watch adds a video to where the person names none, as serve's [watch] default_playlist names it, and null where it names none, so a watch names its playlist.

destinations.description: Each destination the set in force declares, in its order, which a placement takes. A push-only destination is left out, since a placement from review refuses it. side is the side an item placed there takes, and null where the destination drops what it takes. Empty where the set declares none, and null where the set in force could not be read, so the queue still answers.
